active_cases.title: howto_flow.py lists canonical nodes, matches AI metrics lookup, and scaffolds validated 5-tuples
active_cases.cmd: python3 -c "import json, subprocess, sys; r1=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'skills/howto/scripts/howto_flow.py','--list-nodes','--json'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True); d1=json.loads(r1.stdout); assert d1['ok'] and d1['node_count']>=30 and d1['broken_edge_count']==16; r2=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'skills/howto/scripts/howto_flow.py','--lookup','AI metrics','--json'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True); d2=json.loads(r2.stdout); assert d2['ok'] and 'aidash-metrics' in d2['target_skills']; r3=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'skills/howto/scripts/howto_flow.py','--scaffold-tuple','fix bug list','--json'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True); d3=json.loads(r3.stdout); assert d3['ok'] and d3['guard_validation']['ok']"

active_cases.title: Apple OS-Native System Appearance lookup and graph/neighbors navigation
active_cases.cmd: python3 -c "import json, subprocess, sys; r1=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'skills/howto/scripts/howto_flow.py','--lookup','dark mode system theme','--json'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True); d1=json.loads(r1.stdout); assert d1['ok'] and [n['id'] for n in d1['matched_nodes'][:4]]==['E7','P7','E4','E9'] and 'my-designer' in d1['target_skills'] and 'skill-contract' in d1['target_skills'] and 'NSAppearance' in d1['guidance'] and 'prefers-color-scheme' not in d1['guidance']; r2=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'skills/howto/scripts/howto_flow.py','--graph','--json'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True); d2=json.loads(r2.stdout); assert d2['ok'] and len(d2['stages'])==5 and d2['total_edge_count']>50; r3=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'skills/howto/scripts/howto_flow.py','--neighbors','E2'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True); assert 'Local Neighborhood Card: E2 Bug List' in r3.stdout and 'TK-02' in r3.stdout"
